title: Concede
summary: CONCEDE, verb transitive [Latin To yield, give way, depart, desist.] 1. To yield; to admit as true, just or proper; to grant; to let pass undisputed; as, this must not be conceded without limitation.

inlines.v: CONCEDE, verb transitive [Latin To yield, give way, depart, desist.] 1. To yield; to admit as true, just or proper; to grant; to let pass undisputed; as, this must not be conceded without limitation. The advocate concedes the point in question. 2. To allow; to admit to be true. We concede that their citizens were those who lived under different forms.
